meta.title: Creative studio in Tallinn | ARTlab
meta.description: ARTlab is a creative studio for children and adults in Tallinn, offering art, creative workshops, handicrafts, group classes and private lessons.

hero.title: A creative studio for children and adults.
hero.description: Our studio's main focus is visual art. We introduce children and adults to a variety of artistic techniques, teach them to see colour, form and composition, work with different materials and gradually discover their own style.
hero.imageAlt: ARTlab's bright creative studio with worktables and easels

approach.title: More than a beautiful result.
approach.description: For us, creativity is an opportunity to explore, imagine and experiment, to develop your imagination and become more confident in your own ideas.
approach.accent: In every class, we provide a clear foundation and the skills you need, demonstrate techniques and guide you through each stage of the process, while always leaving room for imagination and individual creative choices. This is why even with a shared theme, every piece turns out uniquely personal.

directions.title: A creative path for everyone.
directions.description: Focus on drawing, combine art with three-dimensional techniques, or make beautiful things by hand.

items.title: Visual art
items.description: ARTlab's main direction for children and adults: drawing and exploring colour, form, composition and a wide range of artistic materials.

items.title: Creative workshop 4+
items.description: A space for children who enjoy making as much as drawing: plasticine art, appliqué, decoupage, art collage, three-dimensional projects and mixed media.

items.title: Handicraft club
items.description: Beading, macramé, knitting and other handcraft techniques. Children create their own jewellery, accessories, toys and decorative pieces.

formats.title: Together or one-to-one.
formats.description: We will help you choose a format where you can learn comfortably, try new things and progress at your own pace.

items.title: Small groups
items.description: Classes take place in small groups, allowing the teacher to give personal attention to every participant.

items.title: Private lessons
items.description: The programme and pace are tailored to each student's age, interests and creative goals.

closing.accent: fall in love with creativity from the very first minute.
